From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
History of components of the S&P 500

For a list of the current components of the index, see List of S&P 500 companies.

S&P Dow Jones Indices updates the components of the S&P 500 periodically, typically in response to mergers and acquisitions, corporate spin-offs, or in conjunction with the quarterly rebalancing.[1] Between January 1, 1963, and December 31, 2014, 1,186 index components were replaced by other components. The following is a list of historical changes to the components of the S&P 500:
